summary: This DSH web utility adds an Open-in action to workspace rows so users can launch configured tools such as VS Code, file explorer, or terminal from the GUI for a selected workspace directory.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a DSH web plugin utility for opening workspace directories in user-configured launchers from the UI. README evidence shows it adds workspace row menu entries such as Open in VS Code/Explorer/Terminal and defines configurable targets (command, args, platforms, enabled) with settings persistence, while also noting host-side launcher execution. Because execution is tied to configured commands from user action, risk is limited but includes local process-launch capability.
